name: DeepCura

Best for psychiatrists and multi-specialty practices wanting an all-in-one clinical AI platform.

faqs.q: How much does DeepCura cost in 2026?
faqs.a: DeepCura costs $129/month per provider with 1,000 note credits. Volume discounts: $116/mo (3-5 seats), $110/mo (6-10 seats), $101/mo (11+ seats). Annual option: $999/year (35% off, $83.25/mo equivalent). Practice Fusion users get special $65/mo flat pricing.

Yes. DeepCura is rated as the 'best overall AI scribe for psychiatry in 2026' with structured MSE documentation, risk assessment extraction, therapy note formats (SOAP/DAP/BIRP), and medication management notes.

faqs.q: What makes DeepCura different from other AI scribes?
faqs.a: DeepCura positions itself as an 'Electronic Health Workforce' (EHW)—combining AI scribe, AI receptionist, billing support, and bidirectional EHR integration in one platform. Most competitors focus only on scribing.

faqs.q: Does DeepCura have a free trial?
faqs.a: Yes. DeepCura offers a free trial with no credit card required. All features are included so you can test the full platform before committing.

faqs.q: DeepCura vs Freed: which is better for psychiatrists?
faqs.a: DeepCura ($129/mo) is purpose-built for psychiatry with MSE documentation and medication management. Freed ($39-119/mo) is cheaper and excellent for general medical documentation but less psychiatry-specific. For psychiatrists wanting specialized features, DeepCura. For budget-conscious psychiatric practices, Freed.
